related_prs.body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The selected JP8 cleanup repeatedly prepares the same non-unit dyadic coefficient for consecutive reads of an unchanged source. This finite circuit result shares that preparation across **999 runs / 3,022 additions**, using the existing coefficient-work stream and retaining the original target-update order. It saves **19,688 real-component primitives**: the full forward scalar count decreases from **257,232 to 237,544** (7.65%). Backward has no eligible run and remains at 257,280. **Status: research note / finite complex-supplier circuit improvement; no new kappa.**

Only `research/complex-jp8-cleanup-fusion/` is added. It contains the executable primitive lowering, every run's exact certificate, a cost/prefix argument, source pins, independent arithmetic checks, scoped AI review, local sprint claim, and validation record. No existing supplier, emitter, verifier, selected frontier, or `upstream/` file changes.

The local interface change is explicit: coefficient work is cleared at each new fanout-block boundary, rather than after each original scalar macro. The block preserves arbitrary live inputs and clears arbitrary incoming private work. All source reads, Horner operations, signed accumulations, and clearing are charged. Helper count, paid frame/child profile, wrappers, restoration map, and exact prefix envelopes remain unchanged. Production-emitter integration and global invoice/admission regeneration remain outside this contribution; inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape/recovery, bit-supplier, and analytic assumptions remain. No full multiplication theorem or practical runtime speedup is claimed.

Base: **`66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`**. Selected #626 source: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`; reviewed #622: `f69477f4f6d3c7eb1f740b166881bffed4ffa9f6`; retained #543: `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`. Consumed files and complete gzip payloads have SHA-256 pins; native and event payloads are also checked against #626's SPEC.

OS seed **31** assigned the complex track and selected JP8 by parity. A complete initial scan found no equal directed additions before their first commuting obstruction; the single pivot was shared coefficient preparation in that same cleanup. Both orientation scans are exhaustive for maximal contiguous non-unit common-source/common-magnitude runs, with no sampling, timeout, or optimality claim.

No pinned sprint issue exists, so the claim is local. Full-queue overlap review included 536 open PRs through #717. Related #696 lowers individual scalar macros; this shares work across macros and retains the original Horner preparation. Savings are relative to the selected base and are not asserted additive to #696 without a composed recount. #681 changes a raw factory word; #698 concerns CK B frames; #708/#710 change F2 bit circuits. No pending patch is imported.

The immediate pre-submission refresh reaches #721. Concurrent #719 is credited for its distinct CK cleanup rank-two obstruction: it excludes certain scalar-word replacements, while this JP8 construction preserves the scalar word and shares private coefficient preparation. These results are compatible and neither depends on the other.

## Validation

```sh
python -B research/complex-jp8-cleanup-fusion/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_JP8_SHARED_COEFFICIENT_CLEANUP groups=999 saved=19688 columns=716 orientations=2 controls=10
```

- Native Windows, CPython 3.11.15, standard library only. All 716 arbitrary input columns replay in both orientations. Changed blocks execute explicit primitives; unchanged macros use exact rational semantics. Both inherited rational prefix envelopes match exactly.
- Ten arithmetic controls include missing work clearing, wrong signs/coefficient preparation, aliasing, and three endpoint-neutral prefix excursions.
- `python -B research/complex-jp8-cleanup-fusion/test_verify.py`: seven tests, including all 999 block maps in a separate flat-vector column interpreter, independent grouping/pricing, a noncommuting inverse-transpose witness, emitted-frame and ended-helper mutations, and omitted paid child.
- Isolated optimized Python, minimal copied checkout in a path with spaces, alternate gzip compression, source/receipt corruption, and existing-output preservation checks pass.
- `python -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py` and staged whitespace checks pass. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, global admission, Lean, and remote Linux CI were not run or claimed.

Credit: icekylinx's direct-delivery/factory and emitter lineage; Jeremy Kothe/AtomScout's #622 and JP8 predecessors; DreamingOfClouds' cold-helper/native checks; Chafik Boukhalfa's #626 package; eumemic's #543; and all retained predecessor notices. Prepared for **@ellipsi2 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including one scoped AI reviewer. No independent human review is claimed. New work is Apache-2.0.

related_prs.body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The selected #626 JP8 cleanup prepares each dyadic coefficient independently. This finite circuit contribution reuses its private work stream across consecutive **different coefficient magnitudes** related by powers of two, preserving source values and target-update order. It saves **10,338 additional real-component primitives beyond the equal-magnitude sharing in #722**.

**Status: research construction / finite complex-supplier circuit improvement; no new κ.**

| Complete scalar program | Original | Equal-magnitude sharing (#722 method) | Rescaling |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| JP8 forward | 257,232 | 237,544 | **227,206** |
| JP8 inverse-transpose | 257,280 | 257,280 | 257,280 |

The 30,026 total saving includes #722's 19,688; only the additional 10,338 is new here. All source reads, Horner preparation, doubling/halving, signed accumulation and clearing are charged. The original exact prefix envelopes and paid recursive profiles are unchanged. This is an operation count, not a runtime benchmark.

Only `research/complex-coefficient-rescaling/` is added. It contains executable primitive circuits, all 1,015 block certificates, a written substitution/cost argument, five source pins, an independent DP and scalar-basis checker, negative controls and a local sprint claim. No pending implementation is imported.

The local interface requires clearing private work at **block boundaries**, replacing the selected emitter's per-macro clearing contract inside those blocks. Production-emitter integration and refreshed invoices remain future work. No additional helper, frame transition or recursive child is introduced. The selected supplier, `upstream/`, global ownership and frontier pointer are unchanged. Inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape/recovery, bit-supplier and analytic assumptions remain; this is not a formal multiplication theorem.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-coefficient-rescaling/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_JP8_COEFFICIENT_RESCALING incremental_real_saved=10338 blocks=1015 columns=716 orientations=2 controls=11
```

- Both fixed 27,909-event programs are checked. The complete scalar projections cover all 716 live input columns and arbitrary incoming coefficient work. All 591 distinct JP8 add/scale cases are checked; changed blocks execute literal primitives.
- A separate implementation evaluates 18,925 forward candidate blocks and confirms the restricted optimum. All 6,279 touched-register/work basis cases pass. The 1,211 new magnitude-changing edges are distinguished from 2,023 equal-magnitude edges.
- The full negative census retains 49 nonprofitable transitions (28 ties, 21 losses) and 1,015 incompatible odd-numerator transitions. Backward has no eligible join in this class. No broader circuit-optimality claim.
- Eleven primary controls, four independent semantic controls, and nine additional tests pass, including all 343 signed triples over a seven-value domain, source/receipt corruption, early-ended helpers, relocation and gzip recompression.
- CPython 3.14.7 and 3.11.14 on macOS arm64 pass, including isolated optimized execution. Ruff, local documentation links, staged whitespace and `make selected-record-check` pass.
- Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, global admission, Linux CI and Lean were not run for this isolated research addition.

## Provenance and coordination

Exact base: **`66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`**. Selected #626 source: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`; #622 construction: `f69477f4f6d3c7eb1f740b166881bffed4ffa9f6`; retained #543: `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`. Full gzip payloads and exact plain-file bytes are pinned; native/event hashes additionally match the preserved #626 SPEC.

OS assignment seed **39**, complex-supplier track, selected JP8 by parity. Three candidates and the claim are recorded locally because no pinned coordination issue exists. The final overlap refresh covered **556 open PRs through #737**. #722 is the direct methodological predecessor and comparison. #696/#723 and concurrent #734 optimize individual coefficient preparations; this uses ordinary Horner preparation and shares work between macros. No combined saving with those lowerings is asserted. #681, #698 and #719 cover distinct factory, frame and CK rank questions.

Credit to @ellipsi2's #722, Jeremy Kothe/AtomScout and the #622 lineage, Chafik Boukhalfa's #626 package, icekylinx's scalar/emitter work, DreamingOfClouds, Dugongue, eumemic (including #411), Sagar Thakrar, Chris Pagolu and all retained predecessor notices. **Status: finite complex-supplier circuit improvement / research note; no new κ.**

This adds signed-Horner circuits whose coefficient-work intermediate is bounded by the original numerator at every macro. The existing exact prefix envelopes therefore remain valid. On the selected #626 programs, it saves **3,090 additional real primitives per JP8 orientation and 122 per CK orientation**, beyond the explicitly credited and vendored #696 copy/unit lowering.

Every copy/source access, doubling, signed addition, halving, accumulation and clear is charged. No extra register, recursive child, frame transition or restoration is introduced. The scalar boundaries, dirty-helper restoration and paid profiles are unchanged. Only `research/complex-prefix-bounded-dyadic/` is added.

**Concurrent #723 is credited:** its independent JP8 signed-digit construction saves 3,276 primitives per orientation by permitting numerator+1 and a slightly larger exact forward envelope. This package adds the strict per-macro bound, a proof of the optimal recurrence within that restricted signed-Horner class, CK coverage, and a separate graph crosscheck. Its recoding saves 186 fewer JP8 primitives per orientation; it does not claim a stronger general circuit result. #722 shares preparation across macro boundaries; this package retains clearing after each macro and makes no composition claim with #722 or #723.

```sh
python3 -B research/complex-prefix-bounded-dyadic/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PREFIX_BOUNDED_DYADIC programs=4 columns=716+9 coefficients=686 extra_savings=122,122,3090,3090 controls=12
```

The command freshly executes all four scalar primitive programs on 716 native plus nine arbitrary private formal columns. It checks all 686 distinct coefficient maps and prefix bounds, exact costs, paid histograms and the committed complete coefficient census. An independent forward Dijkstra search agrees with the backward recurrence on all 8,256 target/bound pairs through bound 128. Twelve adverse controls include correct-endpoint overshoot, missing restoration, aliasing and inflated cost.

Validation passed on Linux CPython 3.12.14, 3.14.7 and 3.15.0, including isolated optimized execution. Minimal-checkout reproduction in a path with spaces, altered gzip packaging, four source/receipt/algorithm corruption controls and read-only snapshots pass. `make selected-record-check`, local documentation links and staged whitespace pass. No full `make verify`, cold supplier rebuild, global admission, phase regeneration, remote CI or Lean run is claimed.
